description: Labeled fixture for the input-guardrail eval signal (SCRUM-570, consumed by SCRUM-564 Slice 3). The refusal_when_oos_rate metric (introduced by SCRUM-564 into scripts/run_qa_eval.py) consumes this fixture to measure: (a) the false-positive rate on `legitimate` cases — every refusal here is over-blocking and harms UX; (b) the true-positive rate on `off_scope` + `injection` cases — every refusal here is the gate working as intended. Labels are mutually exclusive. The legitimate set deliberately includes phrases that *contain* common injection-trigger words inside otherwise-real session questions ("ignore previous deadlines", "system" as a noun) so the gate can't pass by matching naive substring rules.
